official_platform_sources_checked.fact: Any process thread becoming idle can satisfy the wait; subsequent calls return immediately. Initial-idle success does not guarantee a particular Shell/Tray window exists.
Out-of-context callbacks require the registering thread's message loop; event/process filters support observation without DLL injection. Events are observation, not write authority.
Allows one wait to react to a process HANDLE, queued messages and bounded timeout without periodic polling; return values must be distinguished.
Failure returns NULL and extended error is available; a missing name cannot identify which of two query operations failed.
